about: Hollerhorn Distilling is best known for whiskey, maple “tree spirits” and Austrian-style fruit brandies, so a vodka is something of a departure. The distillery is Karl and Melissa Neubauer’s family operation in the hills outside Naples, at the head of Canandaigua Lake, opened in 2018 and rebuilt after a fire in 2022. Karl makes every spirit himself, drawing on years of study with master distillers and a family tradition of Austrian schnapps.

Ryeval is made from 100% New York rye, so it is as local as the distillery’s whiskeys. The grain is fermented with a proprietary yeast strain chosen for the fruity, creamy character it leaves in the spirit, then distilled in Naples and bottled at 80 proof. Rye gives vodka more texture and a hint of spice compared with corn or wheat. Hollerhorn describes it as soft and delicate, with a fruity nose and a subtle, sweet finish.
title: Hollerhorn Distilling Ryeval Rye Vodka
